items.evidence: The acceptance test passes. It asserts a non-zero exit and an error line with 'PlayerView-boundary' and 'REQ-025.1' in each probe file's stylish block, and it fails against the base config. Holdout: my own type-position probes all fail with the boundary message. They cover an indexed-access qualifier (import(...)['HandState']), typeof import(...).createHand, a .js-suffixed hand path, deck.js, invariants, bot-random, the non-normalized paths advice/../ and ./../, the import-attributes form, a dotted qualifier (Action.Foo), storage/table types, a nested styles/ folder and upper-case ENGINE.

The acceptance test passes. It asserts zero severity-2 messages for all 9 allowed type-position imports and for lintFiles(src/bots), with a non-empty result. Holdout: PlayerView<string> generic, hand Street, table/session SessionSeat, `import type * as P` from player-view, and a recommend import all lint clean.

The acceptance test passes for golden, golden.js, golden.ts and type-position golden. Holdout: golden.mjs, ../advice/./golden and ../advice/charts/../golden all fail with the boundary message.

The acceptance test passes: real src/advice + src/bots have zero severity-2 messages; the allowed-helpers probe is clean; golden.ts gets no advice message. findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: type-position import('./Golden') in advice code (or '../advice/Golden' in bots) fails lint the same way the static import does.
